{{MissingInfo|1|enva}} [[File:Tyra.png|thumb|250px|Tyra]] '''Tyra''' (Japanese: '''ミサ''' ''Misa'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP036|The Bridge Bike Gang]]''. She is a member of a {{tc|Biker}} gang who have claimed [[Kanto Route 17|Cycling Road]] as their territory. They battle {{pkmn|Trainer}}s who are traveling across the bridge. She and [[Chopper]], another member of the gang, are old friends of [[Jessie]] and [[James]], as they were once part of the bike gang. Tyra battled {{an|Misty}} with her {{p|Cloyster}}. Tyra seemed to have the upper hand, but because of {{TRT}}'s disturbance, the battle was undecided. Tyra recognized Jessie as "Big Jess". She and the rest of the gang were ultimately scared away by the police; however, upon convincing Jessie, James, and {{MTR}} to ride in the storm, she returned to the cycling road. There, she and the other members helped {{Ash}} deliver the medicine to the sick {{p|Shellder}} in [[Sunnytown]]. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Tyra |pkmn=Cloyster |type1=Water |type2=Ice |img=Tyra Cloyster.png |epnum=EP036 |epname=The Bridge Bike Gang |vajp= |vaen=Michael Haigney |desc=Tyra used her {{p|Cloyster}} in her battle against {{an|Misty}}. At first, Misty attempts to use her {{TP|Misty|Starmie}}, but {{TP|Misty|Psyduck}} popped out instead, and Misty decided to give it a try. Psyduck hadn't any clues about what it was supposed to do, and so Tyra and the bike gang roared with laughter. Misty told Psyduck to use {{m|Tail Whip}}, which didn't give any result and only got the gang laughing harder. Upon Tyra's command, Cloyster then opened its shell and used Clamp on Psyduck's tail, causing it to scream in pain. Due to this, Tyra believed that she had won the match, although the battle was ultimately interrupted by {{TRT}}'s disturbance before Psyduck could develop a severe enough headache for its {{type|Psychic}} moves.
